title: borbonia indica

It is a deciduous shrub native to the tropical regions of Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Borbonia indica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to improve cardiovascular health and reduce oxidative stress.
